items.q: Well, when I heard him, he was great. I loved the way he played it. ... So Mr. Wells, eventually he said, 'You know, you and Marlowe Morris and the rest of the gang, and Bill Doggett, owe me an organ, because you learned on my organ!'

ctx.x: Well, when I heard him, he was great. I loved the way he played it. I said, 'Well, that's for me.' He used to make that organ sing. And that's how I started playing organ. When he came up to John(?) Wells' place, he had an organ and piano. Well, the piano players would sit in! So Mr. Wells, eventually he said, 'You know, you and Marlowe Morris and the rest of the gang, and Bill Doggett, owe me an organ, because you learned on my organ!'
You were a very experienced piano player by this time. But was it hard to switch over to organ?
